title: coding-study user doc front matter
description: The YAML front matter of one user page, user-docs/<slug>.md; the file's name is the slug. Spec: docs/specs/user-docs.md#front-matter. coding_study.adapters.fs_user_docs reads the same shape.

title.description: The page's # heading repeats it (check D3)

summary.description: One sentence, shown in lists and search

section.description: The group the page belongs to in lists; a section's pages follow one another in order (check D4)

order.description: The page's place among all pages; no two pages share one (check D4)
